newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel not fit to capture 129.86 yet.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel not fit to capture 129.86 yet.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF gapped higher in early Wednesday trade after a convincing rally on Tuesday, but gains are likely to be limited in the short-term, analysts said.

The contract will have trouble piercing the February high of 129.86, and the psychological 130.00 level. "It may pull back a bit, but as long as 129.50 holds I would stay long," said Martin Scott, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch.
Notionnel whisked though the 129.58 resistance on Wednesday to stand 0.22 higher on the day at 129.64 at 0750 GMT. Monday's high of 129.58 has now become initial support, Scott said.
Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST, said like in Bunds, notionnel charts also signalled limited upside potential and more consolidation in the very short-term.
The hourly RSI was overbought after the September contract touched a near five-month high of 129.76 on Wednesday.
Initial support would come in at 129.36, which Whitby said was a buying level late Tuesday, and the congestion area between 129.20/14.
"That should be the limit to the downside," she said.
At the short-end, September Pibor futures gained 0.02 on the day to trade at 96.57.
